classification: exact-binary-live; isolated test fixture; capability probe only

fixture.project_and_config: temporary isolated directories under the approved local temp root
fixture.plugin: temporary local plugin registering ctx.tool.hook execute.before and execute.after
fixture.task_effect: read-only child returns a fixed synthetic literal; no files changed

proven: In this exact V2 binary and isolated plugin configuration, execute.before receives host sessionID, messageID, call ID, caller agent, and target agent for the native subagent tool.
An execute.before exception prevented the tested native subagent tool body from completing and produced an error result without an after event or child session ID.
For a permitted native call, execute.after preserved the same parent/message/call correlation and returned a child session ID.
not_proven: No durable NativeDispatch PREPARE, receipt, authorization envelope, TaskKernel settlement, verification, ADVANCE, or recovery was exercised.
Plugin absence/unload, multiple-plugin input mutation/order, alternate spawn surfaces, and exact parentage persistence were not tested.
The probe does not prove worker grant enforcement; runtime_grant_enforcement remains OFF/HOLD.
The probe does not provide V1 evidence and does not validate OpenCode 2.0.26 compatibility.
